statement.p: A = {\left\{5,7,8,9,10\right\}}\text{ and } B = {\left\{5,10,11,15,20\right\}} Find each of the following sets.
Your answers should include the curly braces

li.p: A \cup B = {\left\{5,7,8,9,10,11,15,20\right\}}\text{.} It includes everything that is in A or B or both.
A \cap B = {\left\{5,10\right\}}\text{.} It contains everything that is in both A and B\text{.}
A \setminus B = {\left\{7,8,9\right\}}\text{.} It contains everything that is in A except anything that is also in B\text{.} We could also have written this set as A \cap \bar{B}\text{.}

B \setminus A = {\left\{11,15,20\right\}}\text{.} It contains everything in B except anything that is also in A\text{.} Another way to write this is B \cap \bar{A}\text{.} Note that A \setminus B \ne B \setminus A\text{.}
